plain_text:
■ Store documents in electronic archives. No longer print hard copies
for storage in filing cabinets. Establish a routine backup schedule for
electronic files using a network drive, compact disc, disk, or tape.
■ Create a central storage area to file important documents. Rather
than filing multiple copies of an important document throughout the
office, store a single copy centrally. Shared publications, phonebooks,
and files can also be kept centrally rather than buying or printing out
several copies for individual working files.
■ Share computer files on a shared network drive.
